title: Coordinate update and bit flip
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $x\in\{0,1\}^n$, let $i$ be a coordinate, and let $b\in\{0,1\}$. Replacing the $i$th coordinate of $x$ by $b$ gives $x$ if $x_i=b$, and gives the vector obtained by flipping the $i$th bit of $x$ otherwise.
replaced: Let $n\ge0$, $x\in\{0,1\}^n$, $i\in[n]$, and $b\in\{0,1\}$. Replacing $x_i$ by $b$ leaves $x$ unchanged if $x_i=b$ and otherwise gives the vector obtained by flipping bit $i$.
